organization.name_ja: 株式会社アダストリア

affected.note: 1,044,175 customers (second report, 2023-01-24) plus 370,576 customers, employees, job applicants and business partners identified in the third report of 2023-03-31. Customer data included name, address, phone number and email address. Payment and My Number data were not included. Adastria said no leak had been confirmed.

summary.en: Apparel retailer Adastria confirmed unauthorized access to servers of some internal business systems on 2023-01-18. It said personal data of 1,044,175 customers of its DOT.ST online store and related services may have leaked, and later identified about 370,000 more records of customers, employees and applicants.
summary.ja: アダストリアは2023年1月18日に一部業務システムのサーバーへの不正アクセスを確認した。通販サイト「ドットエスティ」などの顧客1,044,175人分の個人情報が流出した可能性があると公表し、その後、顧客、従業員、応募者などの約37万件が新たに対象と判明した。
